The Enterprise Foundation South West, is a not for profit organisation founded by serial entrepreneur Rachel Jones in 2013. Created to raise aspirations and inspire young people, link the business community with educational establishments and to enrich curriculums throughout, the Enterprise Foundation will support the strategic delivery of advice and guidance to young people, in turn leading to great careers and successful enterprise here in Cornwall & Isles of Scilly.

http://www.enterprisefoundationsw.org.uk/
